title: Private preview approval request
description: Reviewed private approval input, for example previews/prices-pr-42.yaml in private GitOps. The preview controller validates each request, derives its immutable instance, source path, source digest and namespace ownership, and enrolls the exact revision. A changed PR revision is never reapproved automatically: it needs a new request. Removing a request retires its instance through the same guarded disposable cleanup. The source definition file previews/definition.json at the approved revision must byte-match the canonical JSON of definition.

service.description: Approved service name. Informational: execution binds repository, revision, image and definition, never the service label.

repository.description: Exact GitHub repository owning the PR. Same-repository forks are rejected.

pullRequest.description: Approved PR number. PR closure retires the instance.

sourceRevision.description: Exact approved PR head SHA. Any other head retires the instance as revision-unapproved.

image.description: Immutable approved image. Synthetic requests require the current platform synthetic image; application images need approved source/signature trust.

platformRevision.description: Exact platform revision rendering the preview workload.

definition.description: Complete restricted workload declaration. Application environments carry bounded non-secret synthetic settings only; no production credentials or persistent storage.

createdAt.description: Approved activation start as UTC epoch seconds, set by the reviewer. Enrollment requires createdAt <= now < expiresAt.

expiresAt.description: Approved expiry as UTC epoch seconds. Lifetime expiresAt-createdAt is 60 to 86400 seconds, at most 3000 with private discovery.
